verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state you can 'Review diffs visually, run multiple sessions side by side' and manage sessions in one 'Agent view', matching the core story, but this is delivered via the web/browser interface and IDE plugins (VS Code, JetBrains) rather than a dedicated native desktop application — no evidence of a standalone desktop app is presented. Missing for 10: confirmation of a true native desktop app, independent/hands-on corroboration of the diff-review and multi-session UI.
